definition_en: a member of your family who lived long before you were born
core_image: 一张发黄的全家福里，站在后排、面容模糊的老人
scene: 祖父翻出家谱，指着最上面几个模糊的名字讲起往事。My grandfather traced our forebears back to a village in the north.
sceneCN: 这里的 forebear 是「祖先」（第 1 个义项：生活在很久以前的家族成员）；句意是祖父把我们的祖先追溯到了北方的一个村子。

collocations.phrase: a forebear of the modern form

derivatives.zh: 由 fore 加 bearer 构成的异体拼写，义同「先辈」，较少使用
同一拼写形式的另一个词，来自古英语 forberan，义为「忍耐；克制」，与本词不同源
同为 fore- 加家族称谓的构词，义为「祖先；先辈」，语气更庄重

senses.title: A family member from long ago
senses.definition: a person in your family line who lived many generations earlier
senses.definitionCN: 家族血脉中生活在许多代以前的成员
senses.example: Her forebears settled here centuries ago.
senses.exampleCN: 她的祖先几个世纪前就在此定居。
senses.why: The fore- element sits before the noun like a marker of what came earlier, and bear here means a person who carries on a line.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 fore- 把「在前」放在名词前面，标识更早的那一代，而 bear 在这里指延续血脉的人。

senses.title: The ancestors of a people
senses.definition: the earlier generations of a people or group, regarded as the source of its traditions
senses.definitionCN: 一个民族或群体的前代成员，被视为其传统的源头
senses.example: The forebears of this tribe left paintings on the cave walls.
senses.exampleCN: 这个部落的先民在洞壁上留下了壁画。
senses.why: When the line belongs to a whole people rather than one family, the same word widens from kin to heritage.
senses.whyCN: 当这条血脉属于一个民族而不只是一个家庭时，这个词就从亲属扩展到文化传承。

senses.title: An earlier version of a thing
senses.definition: an earlier form or version from which a later one developed
senses.definitionCN: 更早的形式或版本，后来的事物由之发展而来
senses.example: The steam engine was the forebear of the modern turbine.
senses.exampleCN: 蒸汽机是现代涡轮机的前身。
senses.why: Because a forebear is what came before, machines, styles and words can take one too, once the family image is loosened.
senses.whyCN: 因为先辈就是「先于我们存在者」，一旦把家族意象放宽，机器、风格和词语也可以有先辈。

intro.en: Forebear joins the prefix fore-, meaning before, to a noun form whose exact origin is disputed.
intro.cn: forebear 由表示「在前」的前缀 fore- 加上一个来源尚有争议的名词部分组成。

items.en: The prefix fore- means before or in front, as in forehead and foresee.
items.cn: 前缀 fore- 意为「在之前、在前方」，如 forehead（前额）与 foresee（预见）。

items.en: The second element is usually explained as bear in the sense of one who bears or carries on a line.
items.cn: 第二个成分通常被解释为 bear，取其「承载、延续血脉的人」之义。

items.en: The spelling forebear appears in the sixteenth century; an older variant shares the form of the verb forbear.
items.cn: forebear 这一拼写见于十六世纪；更早的一种异体与动词 forbear 同形。

items.en: Sources differ: some connect the second element with an old word for a peasant or tiller, so the origin remains uncertain.
items.cn: 各家说法不一：也有学者把第二个成分联系到表示「农夫、耕作者」的旧词，因此来源不确定。

items.en: Modern dictionaries usually treat forebear as the ancestor noun and forbear as the separate verb meaning to hold back.
items.cn: 现代词典一般把 forebear 看作「祖先」名词，把 forbear 看作表示「克制」的另一个动词。

note.en: Look-alike words share the fore- prefix or a role in a family line, while near-meaning words sit on either side along that line.
note.cn: 形近词共享 fore- 前缀，或在家族谱系中占据相近位置；近义词则分布在这条血脉线的两侧。

entries.definition: an ancestor, especially one of a people or movement
entries.definitionCN: 祖先；先辈，尤指一个民族或运动的先驱者

entries.definition: to hold back from doing something
entries.definitionCN: 忍耐；克制不做某事；与 forebear 同形而异音，词源不同

entries.definition: a person or thing that came before another
a person from whom one is descended
entries.definitionCN: 祖先；祖宗，最通用、最中性的说法

entries.definition: a person who comes from an earlier ancestor
entries.definitionCN: 后代；后裔，与「祖先」相对的另一端

entries.definition: the traditions and culture passed down from earlier generations
entries.definitionCN: 遗产；传统，指先辈留下的文化，而非先辈本人

normalIntro.en: Forebear is the person who stands before us in the family line, with fore- marking the earlier place.
normalIntro.cn: forebear 是站在家族血脉前方的那个人，fore- 标出更早的位置。

normal.en: fore- means before, as in forehead and forecast.
normal.cn: fore- 意为在前，如 forehead（前额）与 forecast（预报）。

normal.en: Put the stress on the first syllable: FORE-bear.
Do not confuse forebear with forbear, the verb meaning to hold back.
normal.cn: 别把 forebear 与动词 forbear（克制）混为一谈。

normal.en: Our forebears came from the north.
normal.cn: our forebears 指我们的祖先。

normal.en: Compare ancestor, the everyday word, and forebear, the more literary one.
normal.cn: 对比 ancestor（日常用词）与 forebear（更书面）。

abstract.en: Picture an old photograph on a shelf, faces fading with age.
abstract.cn: 想象架上的一张老照片，面孔随年月渐渐模糊。

abstract.en: See longer rows of relatives standing quietly behind you.
abstract.cn: 想象身后面貌相似的一排排亲属静静站着。

abstract.en: Imagine a steam engine standing next to a modern turbine.
abstract.cn: 想象一台蒸汽机立在现代涡轮机旁边。

examples.en: Her forebears came from a fishing village in the south.
examples.cn: 她的祖先来自南方的一个渔村。

examples.en: The forebears of this tribe used stone tools.
examples.cn: 这个部落的先民使用石器。

examples.en: This engine is a distant forebear of the modern turbine.
examples.cn: 这台发动机是现代涡轮机的远祖。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「fore（在前）+ bear（承载）」——走在前面、替我们承载血脉的人，就是祖先；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 日耳曼语前缀 fore-（在前，古英语 fore）加 bear（承载，古英语 beran）→ 英语 forebear（祖先），核心义「在家族血脉中走在我们前面的人」；前缀 fore- 同见 forehead、forecast、forefather。

sensesIntro.en: Forebear starts with a family member from long ago, widens to the earlier generations of a whole people, and finally covers any earlier form.
sensesIntro.cn: forebear 先从很久以前的一位家人出发，扩展到整个民族的前代，最后也指任何更早的形式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old photograph with people standing in a row.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张站着一排人的老照片。

branches.en: A great-grandparent in the family line.
branches.cn: 家族血脉中的曾祖父一辈。

branches.en: The earlier generations of a people.
An early model of a later machine.
A family member honoured by a whole culture is a forebear of that people.
branches.cn: 被整个文化敬奉的家族成员，就是该民族的先辈。

branches.en: Both a grandparent and an old engine stand earlier in a line of descent.
branches.cn: 曾祖父与旧式发动机都站在派生谱系的更早一端。

intro.en: Fore- means before or in front, as in forefather, forehead and foresee, and much of the fore- family describes what comes earlier.
intro.cn: fore- 表示「在前」，如 forefather、forehead 与 foresee，fore- 家族的大部分词都描述更早的事物。

latinIntro.en: Latin has no direct fore- equivalent; its before is expressed by prae-, pro- and ante-, as in praedictio and antecessor, the Latin source of ancestor.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语没有直接对应的 fore-，它的「在前」由 prae-、pro- 与 ante- 表达，如 praedictio（预言）与 antecessor（ancestor 的拉丁来源）。

items.example: Fore- is the leading element in forebear.
items.exampleCN: fore- 是 forebear 的前置成分。

items.meaning: to carry or give birth to
items.example: Bear supplies the carrier image.
items.exampleCN: bear 提供「承载者」的意象。

items.example: Forbear is a separate word from forebear.
items.exampleCN: forbear 是与 forebear 不同的另一个词。

items.example: Forefather uses the same fore- prefix.
items.exampleCN: forefather 使用同一个 fore- 前缀。

items.meaning: the front part of the head
items.example: Forehead shows fore- meaning the front.
items.exampleCN: forehead 显示 fore- 表示「前部」。

items.example: Forecast adds fore- to a verb of throwing.
items.exampleCN: forecast 把 fore- 加在投掷动词前。

items.example: Forestall keeps the sense of acting first.
items.exampleCN: forestall 保留了「抢先行事」的含义。

items.example: Forerunner names the one who runs ahead.
items.exampleCN: forerunner 指跑在前面的人。

latinEntries.example: Ante is the Latin word for before.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ante 是拉丁语中表示「之前」的词。
antecessor 是 ancestor 的来源。
prae- 的作用类似英语的 fore-。

definition_en: an ancestor, especially one honoured as an early leader of a people or movement
core_image: 村口石碑上刻着的一排人名，一位白发老人排在第一位
scene: 学校讲校史，讲到创办这所学校的几位老人时，全场安静下来。The forefathers of the school planted that tree a century ago.
sceneCN: 这里的 forefather 是「先辈、创办者」（第 2 个义项：一个群体或事业被尊崇的早期人物）；句意是这所学校的先辈们一个世纪前种下了那棵树。

pos.zh: 祖先；先辈；鼻祖；群体开创者

derivatives.zh: 把 father 换成 mother 构成的配对词，义为「女祖先」
同用 fore- 前缀的近义词，义为「祖先」，语气较书面
father 加 land 构成的复合词，义为「祖国」，与 father 意义相关

senses.title: A male ancestor in your family
senses.definition: a male ancestor who lived long ago, especially in your own family
senses.definitionCN: 很久以前的男性祖先，尤指自己的家族成员
senses.example: He honoured his forefathers by keeping the old family name.
senses.exampleCN: 他保留着古老的姓氏，以此敬奉自己的祖先。
senses.why: Fore- puts the father figure before us in time, so the word first names the grandfathers of a blood line.
senses.whyCN: fore- 把父辈形象放到时间的前方，所以这个词首先指血脉中的那些祖父辈。

senses.title: An honoured early leader of a people
senses.definition: an early leader or founder honoured by a group, nation or movement
senses.definitionCN: 被一个群体、国家或运动尊崇的早期领袖或创始人
senses.example: The forefathers of the nation signed the treaty in this hall.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家的先辈们在这座大厅里签署了条约。
senses.why: When the whole nation looks back, the respected father figure becomes a founder standing at the start of common history.
senses.whyCN: 当整个民族回望时，受尊敬的父辈形象就变成了共同历史开端的奠基者。

senses.title: The originator of a field or idea
senses.definition: a person who first started a field of study, a practice or a technique
senses.definitionCN: 最早开创某个研究领域、做法或技术的人
senses.example: Many scientists call him a forefather of modern chemistry.
senses.exampleCN: 许多科学家称他为现代化学的奠基者。
senses.why: Since a father starts a family, the same word naturally names the one who starts a discipline or tradition.
senses.whyCN: 既然父亲开创了家庭，同一个词自然也能指开创某门学问或传统的人。

intro.en: Forefather is a transparent English compound of fore-, meaning before, and father, which goes back to a Germanic root.
intro.cn: forefather 是构词清晰的英语复合词：表示「在前」的 fore- 加上可追溯到日耳曼词根的 father。

items.en: The reconstructed form fader names the father, and it passes into Old English as fæder.
items.cn: 重构形式 fader 指父亲，后来进入古英语作 fæder。

items.en: Fore- already meant before or in front, as in compounds such as foreman.
items.cn: 古英语中 fore- 已表示「在前、先前」，如 foreman 一类复合词。

items.en: The modern spelling father settles, giving the form that modern compounds still use.
items.cn: 现代拼写 father 定型，成为现代复合词至今沿用的形式。

items.en: The compound forefather appears in sixteenth century English, naming ancestors and then founders.
items.cn: 复合词 forefather 出现于十六世纪的英语，先指祖先，继而指奠基者。

items.en: The plural form became closely linked with the founders of the United States.
items.cn: 其复数形式后来与美国的建国者紧密联系在一起。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers fore- words and father words, while the near-meaning group offers the neutral and the opposite words for ancestors.
note.cn: 形近组汇集 fore- 词与 father 词，近义组则给出指祖先的中性说法与相反说法。

entries.definition: a worker who leads a group of other workers
the most important or the first in order
the country where one was born
entries.definitionCN: 祖国，与 forefather 共享 father 一词

entries.definition: a person from whom one is descended
entries.definitionCN: 祖先；祖宗，最通用的说法

entries.definition: the male head of a family or people
a person who comes from an earlier ancestor

normalIntro.en: Forefather simply stacks fore- before father, so read it as the father figure who came first.
normalIntro.cn: forefather 就是把 fore- 叠在 father 前面，直接理解成「先出现的父辈」。

normal.en: fore- means before, as in forecast and forehead.
normal.cn: fore- 意为在前，如 forecast（预报）与 forehead（前额）。

normal.en: In American history, the forefathers are the founders.
normal.cn: 在美国历史里，forefathers 指开国先辈。

normal.en: The foremothers form the matching female term.
normal.cn: foremothers 是与之对应的女性说法。

normal.en: Compare ancestor, which is neutral and more common.
normal.cn: 对比 ancestor，它更中性、更常用。

abstract.en: Picture an old engraved stone with a row of names.
abstract.cn: 想象一块刻着一排人名的旧石碑。

abstract.en: See a hall full of people standing in silence for the founders.
abstract.cn: 想象满厅的人为 founders 起立默哀。

abstract.en: Imagine a white-bearded man standing at the head of a long table.
abstract.cn: 想象一位白须老人站在长桌的首位。

examples.en: Their forefathers farmed this land for generations.
examples.cn: 他们的祖辈在这片土地上耕作了好几代。

examples.en: Their forefathers sailed across the sea in a wooden boat.
examples.cn: 他们的先辈乘木船漂洋过海。

examples.en: Some call him a forefather of modern geography.
examples.cn: 有人称他为现代地理学的奠基者。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「fore + father」——先出现的那位 father，就是先辈；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 日耳曼语前缀 fore-（在前，古英语 fore）加 father（父亲，古英语 fæder，源自重构形式 fader）→ 英语 forefather（祖先；先辈），核心义「先于我们存在的父辈」；同前缀词有 forehead、forecast、forebear。

sensesIntro.en: Forefather starts as a male ancestor of one family, rises to the honoured founders of a people, and finally covers the originator of any field.
sensesIntro.cn: forefather 先从某一家族的男性祖先出发，上升到受尊崇的民族奠基者，最后指任何领域的开创者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stone tablet listing the names of the founders.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块刻着奠基者名字的石碑。

branches.cn: 许多代以前的祖父一辈。

branches.en: The revered founders of a nation.
branches.cn: 一个民族尊崇的奠基者。

branches.en: The first person to start a discipline.
branches.cn: 最先开创一门学科的人。

branches.en: A family ancestor can become a national founder in memory.
branches.cn: 家族祖先在记忆中可以升格为民族奠基者。

branches.en: Both honoured leaders and field pioneers stand at the start.
branches.cn: 受尊崇的领袖与领域先驱都站在开端之处。

intro.en: Fore- carries the before sense and -father supplies the person, two plain English parts joined in a transparent compound.
intro.cn: fore- 承载「在前」之意，father 提供人物主体，两个朴素的英语成分构成一个透明的复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin equivalent of the before element is ante-, as in antecessor; the Latin word for father is pater, behind English paternal and patron.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表示「在前」的成分是 ante-，如 antecessor；拉丁语中父亲是 pater，为英语 paternal 与 patron 的来源。

items.example: Fore- opens the compound forefather.
items.exampleCN: fore- 开启复合词 forefather。

items.example: Father is the person element.
items.exampleCN: father 是人物主体。

items.example: Foremother is the female twin of forefather.
items.exampleCN: foremother 是 forefather 的女性对应词。

items.meaning: the native country of a person
items.example: Fatherland reuses the father element.
items.exampleCN: fatherland 复用了 father 一词。

items.example: Forehead shows fore- in a body part.
items.exampleCN: forehead 显示 fore- 用于身体部位。

items.example: Forecast carries fore- into weather words.
items.exampleCN: forecast 把 fore- 带进天气词汇。

items.example: Foreword means words placed before.
items.exampleCN: foreword 指放在前面的话。

items.example: Foreman puts the leading person first.
items.exampleCN: foreman 把领头人物放在前面。

items.example: Foremost uses the superlative ending.
items.exampleCN: foremost 使用了最高级词尾。

latinEntries.example: Pater lies behind paternal and patron.
latinEntries.exampleCN: pater 是 paternal 与 patron 的词源。

latinEntries.example: Ante plays the part of fore-.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ante 承担 fore- 的角色。

definition_en: a piece of high land that sticks out into the sea, or a stretch of land in front of a larger area
core_image: 一道山脊伸进海里，尽头立着一座孤零零的灯塔
scene: 雾散之后，山脊的尽头露出海面，渔船正从那里绕行。A lighthouse stands on the foreland at the mouth of the bay.
sceneCN: 这里的 foreland 是「岬角」（第 1 个义项：伸入海中的高地）；句意是海湾口的高岬上立着一座灯塔。

derivatives.zh: 同义复合词，由 head 加 land 构成，义为「岬；海角」
同为 fore- 加地类名词的构词，义为「前景；最突出的位置」
同为 fore- 加场所名词的构词，义为「前院；前方空地」

senses.title: A headland jutting into water
senses.definition: a point of high land that projects into the sea or a lake
senses.definitionCN: 伸入海中或湖中的一片高地
senses.example: Waves break against the foreland of the bay.
senses.exampleCN: 海浪拍打着海湾伸出的岬角。
senses.why: Fore- marks what stands in front and land is the ground, so the part of land that pushes forward into water is a foreland.
senses.whyCN: fore- 标出「在前」的部分，land 指陆地，向前伸进海水的那块地就是岬角。

senses.title: The land at the front of a region
senses.definition: the strip of land lying in front of a larger unit such as a mountain range
senses.definitionCN: 位于山脉等较大地形单元前方的那片地带
senses.example: Farmers work the foreland below the mountain range.
senses.exampleCN: 农民在山脉前方的前沿地带耕作。
senses.why: From a mountain, the flat ground in front is literally the land before it, so foreland names that leading strip.
senses.whyCN: 站在山上看，前面那片平地字面上就是「山前的土地」，所以 foreland 指这条前沿地带。

senses.title: New land built out at a coast
senses.definition: new ground built out in front of an old shoreline at a river mouth or delta
senses.definitionCN: 在河口或三角洲处、建于旧岸线前方的成片新陆地
senses.example: The river built a wide foreland at its mouth over centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 几个世纪以来，这条河在入海口填出了宽阔的前陆。
senses.why: Italian forelande, recorded in the sense of mainland, shows land named from its position out in front.
senses.whyCN: 意大利语 forelande 曾以「本土、内陆」之义被记录，说明这类地名来自「处在前方」的位置。

intro.en: Foreland is a transparent compound of fore-, meaning in front, plus land, and related forms appear in older Italian.
intro.cn: foreland 是「在前」的 fore- 加 land 的透明复合词，较早的意大利语中也有相关形式。

items.en: Fore- already meant before or in front, and land meant earth or territory.
items.cn: 古英语中 fore- 已表示「在前」，land 表示土地或领地。

items.en: The compound joining fore- and land names a strip of ground lying in front.
items.cn: 由 fore- 与 land 合成的复合词，指位于前方的一带土地。

items.en: Early modern writers apply the word to a stretch of coast or a seaward point.
items.cn: 早期现代作家用这个词指一段海岸或伸向海中的尖角。

items.en: Italian forelande, glossed as mainland, records a related land named from its forward position.
items.cn: 意大利语 forelande 被注为「本土、内陆」，记录了以「在前」命名土地的相近思路。

items.en: Geographers apply the term to high points projecting into the sea.
items.cn: 十九世纪地理学者用这个词指伸入海中的高地。

items.en: Geology uses foreland for the stable area in front of a mountain belt, as in the term foreland basin.
items.cn: 现代地质学用 foreland 指造山带前方的稳定地块，如「前陆盆地」这一术语。

note.en: The look-alike group collects fore- and -land compounds, while the near-meaning group gathers the other words for land pushing into water.
note.cn: 形近组汇集 fore- 词与 -land 复合词，近义组则汇集其他描述伸入水中陆地的词。

entries.definition: an open area in front of a large building
entries.definitionCN: 前院；建筑物前方的空地

entries.definition: the front part of the head
the main mass of land, not the islands
entries.definitionCN: 大陆；本土，与 foreland 共享 land 成分

entries.definition: a narrow piece of land sticking out into the sea
entries.definitionCN: 岬角；海角，最常用的同义词

entries.definition: a long piece of land almost surrounded by water
entries.definitionCN: 半岛，比岬角更大、更细长

entries.definition: a large pointed area of land reaching into the sea
entries.definitionCN: 海角；岬，规模更大，常用于地名

normalIntro.en: Foreland reads as land in front, the part of the coast that pushes out towards the water.
normalIntro.cn: foreland 读作「在前的地」，即海岸上朝水面伸出的那一段。

normal.en: fore- means in front, and land means ground.
normal.cn: fore- 意为在前，land 意为土地。

normal.en: Compare forehead: the front part of the head.
A foreland is a headland by the sea.
It is also the stable ground in front of mountains.
normal.cn: 它也指山脉前方的稳定地块。

normal.en: Stress falls on the first syllable: FORE-land.

abstract.en: Picture a ridge of rock running straight into the waves.
abstract.cn: 想象一道石脊径直伸进海浪里。

abstract.en: See a narrow field lying between you and the mountain.
abstract.cn: 想象你和山之间躺着一片狭长的田地。

abstract.en: Imagine a river spilling new land into the sea each year.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河每年向海里吐出新的陆地。

examples.en: A small lighthouse marks the foreland at the bay mouth.
examples.cn: 一座小灯塔标示着海湾口的岬角。

examples.en: The forelands of this coast are famous for their cliffs.
examples.cn: 这一带海岸的岬角以断崖闻名。

examples.en: Farmers cultivate the foreland in front of the hills.
examples.cn: 农民耕种着群山前方的前沿地带。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「fore（在前）+ land（陆地）」——伸到最前面的那块地，就是岬角；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 日耳曼语前缀 fore-（在前，古英语 fore）加 land（土地，古英语 land）→ 英语 foreland（岬角；前陆），核心义「位于最前方的陆地」；同前缀词有 forehead、forecast、forebear。

sensesIntro.en: Foreland starts as the headland pushing into water, widens to the strip of land in front of a region, and finally names new coastal ground.
sensesIntro.cn: foreland 先从伸入水中的岬角出发，扩展到某片区域前方的一带土地，最后指海岸新生出的陆地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ridge of rock reaching out into the sea.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道伸入海中的岩脊。

branches.en: A rock point standing in the waves.
The flat strip before a mountain range.
Land built up at a river mouth.
Both a headland and a coastal strip stand in front of something larger.
branches.cn: 岬角与沿海地带都位于更大事物之前。

branches.en: A rocky foreland and a muddy river foreland both lead the land forward.
branches.cn: 岩石岬角与河口淤泥地都把陆地推向前方。

intro.en: Fore- means in front and -land names the ground, so foreland belongs to the large family of fore- and land compounds.
intro.cn: fore- 表示在前，land 指地面，因此 foreland 属于 fore- 与 land 复合词的大词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin expresses in front with ante- and sea-land with terra, as in ante (before) and terra (earth), behind English Mediterranean (sea between lands).
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语用 ante- 表示在前，用 terra 表示土地，如 ante（之前）与 terra（土地），后者是英语 Mediterranean（位于海之间的陆地）的来源。

items.example: Fore- leads the compound foreland.
items.exampleCN: fore- 引出复合词 foreland。

items.example: Land supplies the ground element.
items.exampleCN: land 提供「地面」成分。

items.example: Headland is a close synonym.
items.exampleCN: headland 是接近的同义词。

items.example: Mainland shares the land element.
items.exampleCN: mainland 共享 land 成分。

items.meaning: the native country of a person
items.example: Homeland belongs to the same land family.
items.exampleCN: homeland 属同一 land 词族。

items.example: Forehead uses fore- for a body part.
items.exampleCN: forehead 用 fore- 指身体部位。

items.example: Foreground is the ground in front.
items.exampleCN: foreground 就是在前的地面。

items.example: Forecast shows fore- in predictions.
items.exampleCN: forecast 显示 fore- 用于预测。

items.example: Seaboard is a coastal neighbour.
items.exampleCN: seaboard 是沿海词类的邻居。

latinEntries.example: Ante renders the fore- of foreland.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ante 可以对应 foreland 中的 fore-。
mediterraneus 由 terra 与 medius 组合而成。
